value.rationale: The chosen boundary is the minimal reduced simple-normal-crossings stable modification of the classical MacLane eight-line divisor at its precisely eight nonnodal triple points, not an arbitrary graph or coefficient slice. Its complete finite Néron group is a natural degeneration invariant at the minimal disconnected eight-line realization-space example, and the equality for both complex realizations gives a meaningful boundary on the distinguishing power of this invariant. It remains useful without a downstream theorem or classification.
